tips.text: Go on a weekday if you can. Saturdays are much busier.
Have a Silver pass? It isn't valid Dec 14 through Jan 3. You'll need a Gold pass or a day ticket on those dates.
Dollywood doesn't offer AAA discounts, but some AAA offices sell tickets.
